hypotheses_untested: Gradual leaks are missed more often than bursts (recall 0.96 vs 1.00); a longer integration window or trend feature may help.
False alarms are more frequent on episodes with demand spikes (0.07 vs 0.00); lag-compensating the outlet meter may reduce them.
False-alarm episodes have larger meter bias (|bias| 1.14 vs 0.62 L/min); per-episode baseline recalibration may help.
